def isSorted (l : List Int) : Bool :=
  match l with
  | [] => true
  | [_] => true
  | x::y::xs => x ≤ y ∧ isSorted (y::xs)

def count (x : Int) (l : List Int) : Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => 0
  | h::t => (if h = x then 1 else 0) + count x t
